## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by tightening exit parameters for the SUPER quality tier (increasing TP1 to 75% and setting stop to 15%) and adjusting LEVEL/TRENDLINE tier parameters (quantity, stops, TP1s). The edge exists because current parameters may be suboptimal for capturing asymmetric payoffs in volatile regimes while limiting losses during choppy periods.

## Mechanism

Entry logic remains unchanged (BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup triggers). Exit logic changes per quality tier:
- SUPER: stop = -0.15 (15% premium stop), TP1 = 0.75 (75% profit target)
- LEVEL: qty = 18 contracts, stop = -0.12, TP1 = 0.30
- TRENDLINE: stop = -0.06
Runner target fixed at 3.0x premium. All other parameters (chandelier profit-lock, time stops) remain at baseline.
